comments.text: The puck is probably the future. We already essentially use a wireless puck when we do PCVR with VD or whatever. The question comes down to how much compute and battery life you can pack into the thing for a reasonable price. Imagine you were building a really high end mobile device but you don't need to worry about a screen, gyros, speakers, etc. You could pack a ton of compute power, battery, cooling, etc. into something the size of a big smartphone that just dangles behind you or goes in your pocket.
